aka.zh: 弗格森公路（北湾至科克伦）

tagline.en: The long northern way across Ontario: from North Bay through the Clay Belt to Hearst, round Lake Nipigon's south end to Thunder Bay and on to the Rainy River
tagline.zh: 横越安大略的北方长路：自北湾穿过黏土带至赫斯特，经尼皮贡湖南端到桑德贝，再通往雷尼河

start.en: The junction with Highway 71 west of Emo; Highway 11 itself continues about 51 km further to Rainy River and the Minnesota border
start.zh: 埃莫以西与 71 号公路的交会处；11 号公路本身继续向西约 51 公里，通往雷尼河镇与明尼苏达边境

end.en: North Bay, where the four-lane highway from Barrie arrives on the shore of Lake Nipissing
end.zh: 北湾，来自巴里的四车道公路在此抵达尼皮辛湖畔

en: Highway 11 once ran from Toronto to Rainy River and was billed as the longest street in the world. The part in this atlas is the northern one: the Trans-Canada route from North Bay over the Canadian Shield to the Rainy River country on the Minnesota border, nearly all of it a two-lane road through forest, lakes and small resource towns.

From North Bay it runs north past Temagami and the Tri-Town to Cochrane, then turns west across the flat Clay Belt through Kapuskasing and Hearst, with long gaps between towns. It reaches Lake Superior at Nipigon, where it joins Highway 17 for the run to Thunder Bay, then leaves it again westward through Atikokan and Fort Frances.
For heavy traffic it is the alternative to Highway 17 along the lake. Both pass through Nipigon, and the bridge there carries the only road link between eastern and western Canada.
zh: 11 号公路曾从多伦多一直通到雷尼河，号称“世界上最长的街道”。本图集所收的是北段：自北湾越过加拿大地盾、直到明尼苏达边境雷尼河一带的横贯加拿大路线，几乎全程是穿行于森林、湖泊与资源小镇之间的双车道公路。
它自北湾北上，经蒂马加米与“三镇”到科克伦，随后西折，横越平坦的黏土带，经卡普斯卡辛与赫斯特，城镇之间相隔甚远。它在尼皮贡抵达苏必利尔湖，与 17 号公路共线至桑德贝，再向西分出，经阿蒂科肯与弗朗西斯堡。
对重载交通而言，它是沿湖而行的 17 号公路的替代路线。两条路都经过尼皮贡，那里的桥梁承载着加拿大东西部之间唯一的公路连接。

en: The Ferguson Highway from North Bay to the northern mining and farming settlements opened on 2 July 1927 and was extended to Cochrane and later west to Hearst in the 1930s. The westward link from Nipigon to Geraldton opened on 7 September 1940, and the 247 km gap from Geraldton to Hearst, built partly by labour from prison camps, was finished in November 1942 and opened to traffic on 12 June 1943, completing a road across northern Ontario.

West of Thunder Bay, the Atikokan Highway, opened as Highway 120 on 13 August 1954, became part of Highway 11 on 1 April 1960, and the Noden Causeway at Fort Frances opened on 28 June 1965. In 1996 and 1997 the province transferred the section south of Barrie to the municipalities, so Yonge Street is no longer part of it.

The section in this atlas is mostly unchanged two-lane road. Exceptions are the twinning between Nipigon and Thunder Bay and the Nipigon River Bridge, Ontario's first cable-stayed bridge. Forty-two days after its first half opened, on 10 January 2016, one end of the deck lifted about 60 cm when bolts failed, closing the Trans-Canada at Nipigon for about 18 hours. The second half opened in November 2018.
zh: 自北湾通往北部矿区与农垦点的弗格森公路于 1927 年 7 月 2 日通车，20 世纪 30 年代延伸至科克伦，后又西延至赫斯特。向西的尼皮贡至杰拉尔顿段于 1940 年 9 月 7 日通车；杰拉尔顿至赫斯特之间 247 公里的缺口部分由监狱营地劳力修建，1942 年 11 月完工，1943 年 6 月 12 日通车，由此修成一条横贯安大略北部的道路。
在桑德贝以西，阿蒂科肯公路于 1954 年 8 月 13 日以 120 号公路之名开通，1960 年 4 月 1 日并入 11 号公路；弗朗西斯堡的诺登堤道于 1965 年 6 月 28 日通车。1996 至 1997 年，该省将巴里以南路段移交地方政府，因此央街已不再属于这条公路。
本图集所收路段大多仍是原样的双车道公路。例外是尼皮贡至桑德贝之间的加宽工程，以及安大略首座斜拉桥——尼皮贡河大桥。其前半幅通车 42 天后，2016 年 1 月 10 日，因螺栓失效，桥面一端翘起约 60 厘米，横贯加拿大公路在尼皮贡中断约 18 小时。后半幅于 2018 年 11 月通车。

value.en: 1,770.3 km for the whole of Highway 11 from Barrie to Rainy River, summed from the province's 2024 traffic-volume sections; English Wikipedia gives 1,784.9 km. This atlas piece covers North Bay to the Highway 71 junction.
value.zh: 11 号公路全线（巴里至雷尼河）1,770.3 公里，据该省 2024 年交通量路段累加；英文维基百科作 1,784.9 公里。本图集所收为北湾至 71 号公路交会处。

figures.source: Ontario Ministry of Transportation, Provincial Highways Traffic Volumes 2024 (computed); English Wikipedia, Ontario Highway 11

why.en: No total published for a road built in pieces from the 1920s. Recent contracts are known individually: the Nipigon River Bridge was a $106 million project, and six Highway 11/17 twinning contracts east of Thunder Bay ran from $32.7 million to $107 million each, as cited in English Wikipedia, Ontario Highway 11.
why.zh: 这条路自 20 世纪 20 年代起分段修建，未公布总额。近年合同可逐项查到：尼皮贡河大桥项目 1.06 亿加元；桑德贝以东 11/17 号公路的六份加宽合同每份 3,270 万至 1.07 亿加元，据英文维基百科“安大略 11 号公路”条目。

value.en: The province, through the Ministry of Transportation; the Nipigon River Bridge was paid for from Ontario's Northern Highways Program.
value.zh: 省政府，经由交通厅；尼皮贡河大桥由安大略“北方公路计划”出资。

figures.source: Ontario Ministry of Transportation statements on the Nipigon River Bridge; CBC News

value.en: Opened in two halves, November 2015 and November 2018. The deck lifted about 60 cm on 10 January 2016, 42 days after opening; the cause was put down to the design of the shoe plates, the bearings and the bolts. The repair was first estimated at $8–12 million and later exceeded that.
value.zh: 分两半幅通车，分别于 2015 年 11 月与 2018 年 11 月。2016 年 1 月 10 日、通车第 42 天，桥面翘起约 60 厘米；原因归于支座底板设计、支座与螺栓。修复费用起初估计为 800 万至 1,200 万加元，后来超出此数。

figures.source: Ontario Ministry of Transportation; CBC News, 2016–2018

timeline.en: The Ferguson Highway north from North Bay opens on 2 July.
timeline.zh: 7 月 2 日，自北湾北上的弗格森公路通车。

timeline.en: The Nipigon–Geraldton section opens on 7 September.
timeline.zh: 9 月 7 日，尼皮贡至杰拉尔顿段通车。

timeline.en: The Geraldton–Hearst link opens on 12 June, completing a road across northern Ontario.
timeline.zh: 6 月 12 日，杰拉尔顿至赫斯特段通车，横贯安大略北部的道路由此贯通。

timeline.en: The Atikokan Highway becomes part of Highway 11 on 1 April.
timeline.zh: 4 月 1 日，阿蒂科肯公路并入 11 号公路。

timeline.en: The Noden Causeway at Fort Frances opens on 28 June.
timeline.zh: 6 月 28 日，弗朗西斯堡的诺登堤道通车。

timeline.en: The section south of Barrie, including Yonge Street, is transferred to the municipalities.
timeline.zh: 巴里以南路段（含央街）移交地方政府。

timeline.en: Four-laning between Barrie and North Bay is completed on 8 August.
timeline.zh: 8 月 8 日，巴里至北湾的四车道工程完工。

timeline.en: The deck of the new Nipigon River Bridge lifts on 10 January, closing the Trans-Canada for about 18 hours.
timeline.zh: 1 月 10 日，新尼皮贡河大桥桥面翘起，横贯加拿大公路中断约 18 小时。

timeline.en: The second half of the Nipigon River Bridge opens on 23 November.
timeline.zh: 11 月 23 日，尼皮贡河大桥后半幅通车。
